_readme: PHASE 27 dev-set annotation sheet. This is the ONLY file a human edits.
Fill `events` with what the footage visibly supports, then run:
which emits the official evaluate.py GT schema and refuses anything not marked confirmed.
RULES (from HACKATHON_CONTEXT.md section '14 классов' + the phase brief):
* start_sec = first time the event is clearly active; end_sec = last such time.
* label ONLY what is visible. If you cannot tell, use status 'uncertain' and say why.
* never copy a number out of a detector output, a debug CSV, or labels_draft/.
* simultaneous same-class events = ONE segment covering both.
* do not invent events to fill a class; an absent class is a valid, informative label.
uncertain  -> counted and listed, never scored. Explain in `note`.
rejected   -> you looked and decided it is not that class. Explain in `note`.

_class_definitions.accident: contact of two+ road users; start = first visible contact, end = when they stop/leave
_class_definitions.near_miss: hard braking or an evasive swerve that avoids contact
_class_definitions.red_light: crossing the stop line on red; start = the moment the front crosses the line
_class_definitions.wrong_way: travelling against the direction of the lane
_class_definitions.stopped_vehicle: stationary on the carriageway >= 10 s, not queued at a signal
_class_definitions.jaywalking: pedestrian on the carriageway outside a crossing
_class_definitions.failure_to_yield: vehicle going through the crossing while a pedestrian is on it
_class_definitions.illegal_turn: turn from the wrong lane or in a prohibited direction
_class_definitions.stop_line: stopped past the stop line on red without entering the intersection
_class_definitions.congestion: traffic standing/crawling across all lanes of one direction
_class_definitions.road_obstacle: debris, animal or a fallen object on the carriageway
